editorial:
If you love gritty British crime thrillers with a tough-as-nails lead, this one delivers. Jason Statham plays Detective Sergeant Tom Brant, a hard-drinking, no-nonsense cop who gets pulled into a case when a serial killer starts picking off police officers one by one. The killer calls himself "Blitz," and he's bold, loud, and completely unhinged. Brant teams up with Porter Nash, a calm and sharp detective played by Paddy Considine, and together they race to stop the next attack. The vibe is dark, tense, and very London, with rain-soaked streets and a constant sense of danger around every corner.

The action is punchy and the pacing rarely slows down, which keeps you hooked from start to finish. Statham is in his comfort zone here, and Considine adds real heart and depth to the story. The downside is that some plot threads feel rushed, and a few side characters don't get enough screen time. Still, if you enjoy gritty cop movies with sharp dialogue and brutal fights, this is a solid pick. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final act, Brant and Nash close in on Barry Weiss, the man behind the Blitz killings. After a tense chase through London, Brant confronts Weiss and shoots him dead, ending the murder spree for good. The film closes with Brant back on the job, seemingly unbothered by what he's done, while Nash moves on to a new post. It's a blunt, no-frills ending that fits the movie's tough tone, leaving you with the sense that Brant will keep bending the rules to get results.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves gritty cop thrillers with a tough lead and brutal action.
